legend: The peripheral blood smear shows borderline normochromic, normocytic anaemia with increased target cells. There is leukocytosis, with relative and absolute eosinophilia. Eosinophils are morphologically atypical, with an abnormal distribution of cytoplasmic granules. Platelets are adequate and morphologically unremarkable (Giemsa).
The bone marrow clot section is hypercellular (nearly 100%) and shows marked myeloid hyperplasia with a markedly increased myeloid-to-erythroid ratio and increased eosinophils.
The bone marrow aspirate shows increased eosinophils, including immature eosinophilic precursors (Giemsa).

Representative interphase nucleus and metaphase with an abnormal CHIC2 deletion signal pattern: one normal intact dual-colour signal (FIP1L1, green; CHIC2, red / PDGFRA, green) and one abnormal signal (FIP1L1, green / PDGFRA, green) indicating a CHIC2 deletion, using a dual-colour FIP1L1::CHIC2::PDGFRA probe set.
